Reviewed the general create introduction against the owner and executed expiry regression. Seven-day starting expiry produces retained indeterminate receipts with original Session reference and input proof; original keys never execute again, while deliberate separate new keys are permitted. Active slots and pending reserves are freed, but fences remain within the 4 MiB byte budget and can cause capacity pressure. The separate portable attempt protocol is unchanged.

Reviewed the linked API/SDK expiry correction: expired starting keys retain an indeterminate Session reference and never execute again, while deliberate new keys have duplicate risk. This guide correctly routes integration teams to those contracts and their retention/error evidence; it invents no reconciliation or retry capability. No prose change is needed.

Reviewed expiry and admission against the owner and faulted tests: expired original keys remain HTTP 409 indeterminate with their Session reference; changed input conflicts; deliberate separate new keys are allowed after expiry and may duplicate prior effects. Compact expired receipts no longer consume active-count or pending-byte reservations but remain in the bounded ledger. Format 3 upgrades old records before admission so version-1/2 readers reject the new terminal representation. A single bounded read preserves typed 429 byte refusal. Resumed pre-start refusal retries execute once.
